properties.statement: A SCOPED DETECTOR RETURNING `in_scope: 0` OVER `region_size: 1` READS AS A PASS AND IS THE OPPOSITE — SIX INDEPENDENT SESSIONS REPORTED IT IN ONE DAY, WHICH IS THE STRONGEST CORROBORATION IN THE FEEDBACK FILE. Reported separately, without consolidation, by w-10f94d47, w-08baa598, w-fb7d30ab, w-ec25cf2c, w-deac0a1e and w-abbb53d2 across dev_storyflow on 2026-08-07. `detect_gaps` and `detect_defects` scoped to a node return `in_scope`, `out_of_scope` and `region_size`, and REPORTING region_size IS THE THING THAT WORKS — three of the six said so explicitly and one wants it kept on the record as a win: it is what let them state honestly that their zero was narrow-but-real rather than empty (region_size 14, 16, 41 in three cases). THE DEFECT IS THAT THE JUDGEMENT IS LEFT TO THE READER. w-deac0a1e scoped to `dec:core_must_not_import_a_lens` and got `in_scope: 0`, which reads green; it was an ISLAND — the node has no edges, so the detector had exactly one node to look at. They only caught it by running a control on a sibling (`dec:lens_isolation` -> region_size 18, 4 gaps) to prove the measurement could return more at all. Two earlier workers had to caveat the same shape in prose as 'the weakest green in the building'. THE GENERAL POINT, and it is why six reports matter more than one: the tool has the number and the human has to supply the interpretation, and under operational load supplying it is exactly what gets skipped. A vacuous green that reads as a pass is the class this fleet keeps paying for. Noted honestly by one reporter: `detect_defects` DOES name the same situation explicitly as `disconnected_community` — it is the gap detector that reads as green. FIX SHAPE, converged on independently by all six: when region_size is 1 (or the region reaches no node of a type the detector can fire on), say so in the payload — e.g. `caveat: "region is a single isolated node; in_scope: 0 is not evidence of health"`. One field. The information is already computed.
properties.value: {"reported":"2026-08-07 dev_storyflow, six independent sessions: w-10f94d47, w-08baa598, w-fb7d30ab, w-ec25cf2c, w-deac0a1e, w-abbb53d2","filed_separately":"per the feedback file's own no-consolidation rule; consolidated here as one defect with six corroborations","what_works":"region_size being in the payload at all - explicitly credited by three reporters, keep it","defect":"the interpretation of a degenerate region is left to a reader who may not think to caveat it","worst_case_seen":"in_scope 0 over region_size 1 on an edgeless node, caught only by running a control on a sibling","fix_shape":"a caveat/scope_note field when region_size <= 1 or the region contains nothing the detector can fire on","severity":"opportunity, not breakage - nothing failed, the reader carried a rule the output could carry"}
